events.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced bond market intervention program
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the U.S. government would intervene in the bond market by purchasing long-term U.S. Treasury bonds in response to rising 30-year Treasury yields. The program was intended to push up bond prices and lower interest rates to address concerns about higher mortgage rates and government financing costs. Bond markets initially responded but reversed course within one day, with 30-year yields rising over seven basis points to 5.27% by Thursday.
events.why_relevant: Direct government intervention in financial markets to manage debt costs and influence borrowing conditions affects fiscal policy capacity and signals concern about debt sustainability.
events.basis: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the government was intervening in the bond market, with a program to buy long-term U.S. Treasury bonds.

events.title: CDC announces Advisory Board on Radiation and Worker Health meeting scheduled for August 26–27, 2026, in Tampa, Florida, with public comment period.
events.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) published a notice announcing a hybrid meeting of the Advisory Board on Radiation and Worker Health (ABRWH) to be held August 26–27, 2026, in Tampa, Florida. The meeting is open to the public with in-person and virtual access. A public comment session is scheduled for August 26 at 5:15 p.m. EDT. Written comments must be submitted by August 19, 2026. The Advisory Board advises on radiation dose reconstruction, probability of causation guidelines, and petitions to add worker classes to the Special Exposure Cohort under the Energy Employees Occupational Illness Compensation Program Act of 2000.
events.why_relevant: Public notice of an advisory board meeting ensures transparency in the federal compensation program for radiation-exposed workers and provides opportunity for public participation in policy deliberations affecting occupational health protections.
events.basis: In accordance with the Federal Advisory Committee Act, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announces the following meeting of the Advisory Board on Radiation and Worker Health (ABRWH). This is a hybrid meeting, accessible both in person and virtually. It is open to the public, limited only by the space available and the number of audio conference lines and internet conference access, with a public comment period.

events.title: EEOC Commission Meeting Notice Under Sunshine Act
events.summary: The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission published a Sunshine Act notice announcing a public commission meeting scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time at the Jacqueline A. Berrien Training Center in Washington, DC. The meeting will address the EEOC Strategic Plan for Fiscal Years 2026–2030 and a draft notice of proposed rulemaking revising Federal-sector EEO complaint regulations (29 CFR part 1614). The meeting will be open to public observation in person and via listen-only audio, with ASL services and closed captioning provided. Attendees must register in advance by email.
events.why_relevant: Sunshine Act notices ensure public transparency and observation of federal agency deliberations and voting, a foundational democratic accountability mechanism.
events.basis: The meeting will be open to the public" and "In accordance with the Sunshine Act, the public will be able to observe the Commission's deliberations and voting.
